definitions: A basic, often hand-drawn or digital sketch, representation of a product or system interface, used early in the design process to visualize concepts and gather initial feedback.
An early, simplified version of a product or system, lacking most of the final design details and functionality, created to test fundamental ideas and user flows.
examples: We started with a low fidelity prototype to quickly iterate on the layout.
The team used a low fidelity prototype to test the core navigation.
Feedback on the low fidelity prototype helped us refine the user journey.
